items.question: What is the customs duty rate in Dubai on alcohol imports?
items.gold: 50 per cent duty is payable for alcohol.
items.fact: Dubai customs duty on alcohol is 50 percent.

items.question: What is the maximum number of digits in a UAE Harmonized System Code (HS Code) for classifying traded goods?
items.fact: HS Codes use numeric codes of up to six digits.
